configuration.purpose: F16 fails compilation: this installed utils/x_hls_utils.h exposes fp_struct globally, and unary-minus ap_int<11> returns ap_int<12>, making a conditional with ap_int<11> ambiguous. Use the actual SDK symbol and explicit sign/magnitude branches. This is a source-typing fix with the same paper estimates and exact arithmetic. F08 write_output reports3DSP,534LUT,547FF and3.239ns estimated clock for float(raw10)/256. Every raw10 value is exactly representable in binary32. Exhaust all1024 raw values across three orderings, including zero,-512,511 and negative fractions, comparing binary float bits to ordinary division. Construct sign/exponent/significand using the installed hls::fp_struct<float>; no floating arithmetic, unsafe pointer aliasing, rounding or precision change.
